claims.text: NeuronBlocks includes various neural network modules such as embedding layers, RNN, CNN, Transformer, attention mechanisms, and regularization layers.
The toolkit supports multiple attention layers including Linear/Bi-linear Attention and Full Attention.
NeuronBlocks provides loss functions beyond those in PyTorch, including options like Focal Loss.
Metrics for classification and sequence labeling tasks are also included in NeuronBlocks.
